overview: Arenas on demand. Pick a preset from a menu and a fresh piece of ground is made for the fight, floating alone in a dimension of its own, gone when the clock runs out.

1.1.0: The arena is a menu now: arenas, join, loadout, begin and leave are buttons rather than things you type in the middle of a fight.

A match ends by saying the score it was actually played for, banks filled, flags taken or the hill held, instead of a line about kills, and says so plainly when the clock runs out with nobody ahead. A team's bank is counted even when nobody is standing near it, so the board stops quietly drifting.
Dying outside an arena puts you back in your own bed again rather than at some arena's door with the respawn button greyed out.
1.0.1: Two new games: the odd one out, where everybody but one is dealt the place and the room has to find who was not, ending in a scramble anybody can call; and a snowball fight scored by what lands rather than by damage. Players sit down while the talking is on.
A plain teleport into or out of an arena is now refused, and says what the door does, instead of being quietly undone afterwards.
1.0.0: /pvp opens a menu of presets: a fresh arena inside a border, everyone invited with a button in chat, the empty obsidian frame beside you lit as a way in, and everybody sent home when the time is up. Admins make and edit presets, users start the ones marked for them.
